paragraphs.text: Storrev is a Devkarin elven lich and leader of the Erstwhile , a zombie faction within the Golgari Swarm of Ravnica .

Storrev is adept at the politics of court, and she is feared for her power to transform dead beasts into undead horrors . In the period leading up to the War of the Spark , the Golgari used the Erstwhile as servants. When Vraska came after the guildmaster Jarad vod Savo , Storrev turned tables on her master and joined Vraska's alliance.

As Mazirek was the one who had awakened the Erstwhile, none of them - even free-willed liches like Storrev - could disobey a direct order or refuse a question from him. However, when Mazirek formed an alliance with Nicol Bolas and betrayed Vraska, Storrev misled him and had him killed by a Rakdos Comedy Troupe.
Storrev remains an ally of Vraska because the gorgon had freed the Erstwhile and had given them Mazirek, who had been their tormentor, to kill.
